documentation_summary: SiliconFlow distinguishes internal reasoning thinking_budget from visible-response max_tokens; it cautions that some models may continue reasoning beyond thinking_budget. This supports, but does not fully establish, the semantics of the OpenRouter route.
finding: Observed total completion tokens exceed requested max_tokens. Existing client reservations are heuristics, not a guaranteed provider-enforced total-token or invoice cap.
action: Preserve the running frozen qualification execution and raw receipts. Do not scale production using an assumed 2048 total-completion-token ceiling.
